notes.title: Rattus Velocitas update released.
notes.content:
[p]G'day Rat Racers. [/p][p][/p][p]This patch adds some way overdue updates to the scoreboard and makes the game a lot more predictable on certain older AMD graphics systems, in addition to other bugfixes and optimisations. [/p][list][*][p]Made the Race Results scoreboard only show Rats that have finished their race if it's still running when all Human players finish.[/p][/*][*][p]The Race Results scoreboard now shows finish times for every participant! :)[/p][/*][*][p]The game now calculates the finishing position at the end of the race based on the race time, rather than the order players touched the finish line trigger.[/p][/*][*][p]Significantly improved determinism of gameplay actions and physics. [b]NOTE: This will desync existing replays, due to the physics behaving slightly differently![/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a long-standing bug where item throwing trajectories in replays were off by 1 frame, causing some item throwing trajectories to fail to reproduce correctly. [b]NOTE: This bugfix only reliably fixes replay files recorded with this patch onward. Older ones may be fixed too but it is not guaranteed.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing the starting and looping parts of background music to desync on lower end CPUs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the fadeout to the Race itself from the loading screen would happen instantly on lower end CPUs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a startup crash on older AMD Adrenalin graphics drivers on Windows if the Steam Overlay was enabled [b]and[/b] the computer had just been started up. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the game hanging when loading a race on some systems.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the game's first tutorial prompt wouldn't appear on first game launch.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where setting an Antialiasing setting higher than 2x MSAA on some AMD graphics systems would crash instantly and prevent the game launching again. 
[b]NOTE: This bugfix may increase VRAM usage. Please make sure your graphics card has 1GB of video memory or more for optimal performance.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Significantly optimised rendering performance. [/p][/*][*][p]Temporarily removed the "Unrestricted" option from the FPS cap dropdown - this setting was causing stability issues on some AMD graphics systems. (again) [/p][/*][*][p]Workaround a bug where the game would erroneously show as running in Steam after game shutdown if the Game Manual was opened during the game session with certain PDF viewers. [b]NOTE: This means for now that a file browser window will open instead in the game data directory where the Game Manual is located. I will have a better solution in a later game update.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Known issues:[/p][list][*][p]Some combinations of graphics settings and AMD graphics cards on Windows may cause the game to repeatedly crash on startup; if this happens to you, try deleting %userprofile%/AppData/LocalLow/Hedgehog Arts/Rattus Velocitas/settings/settings.json and relaunching the game. 
Settings to avoid in particular on Adrenalin driver 22.6.1 (which is the last supported driver on a [b]lot [/b]of AMD hardware and is the primary culprit of all crashes on the Vulkan renderer) are MSAA, Vsync and Frame Blending. [b]If your graphics card is of RDNA1 generation or newer, please try updating your AMD drivers instead![/b][/p][/*][*][p]The flashing lights in Space Station flash in sync rather than at random times. This will be fixed in a future patch.[/p][/*][*][p]On some systems, alt-tab will sometimes crash the game. Again, if you're on AMD hardware and have an RDNA1 generation graphics card or newer, try updating your drivers if this happens to you.[/p][/*][*][p]Sometimes sounds from despawned Missiles will linger in splitscreen multiplayer after despawning.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Made the Race Results scoreboard only show Rats that have finished their race if it's still running when all Human players finish.
The Race Results scoreboard now shows finish times for every participant! :)

tags.balance_change: The game now calculates the finishing position at the end of the race based on the race time, rather than the order players touched the finish line trigger.

tags.bug: Fixed a long-standing bug where item throwing trajectories in replays were off by 1 frame, causing some item throwing trajectories to fail to reproduce correctly. [b]NOTE: This bugfix only reliably fixes replay files recorded with this patch onward. Older ones may be fixed too but it is not guaranteed.[/b]
Fixed a bug causing the starting and looping parts of background music to desync on lower end CPUs.
Fixed a bug where the fadeout to the Race itself from the loading screen would happen instantly on lower end CPUs.
Fixed a startup crash on older AMD Adrenalin graphics drivers on Windows if the Steam Overlay was enabled [b]and[/b] the computer had just been started up.
Fixed the game hanging when loading a race on some systems.
Fixed a bug where the game's first tutorial prompt wouldn't appear on first game launch.

Fixed a bug where setting an Antialiasing setting higher than 2x MSAA on some AMD graphics systems would crash instantly and prevent the game launching again. 
[b]NOTE: This bugfix may increase VRAM usage. Please make sure your graphics card has 1GB of video memory or more for optimal performance.[/b]

Workaround a bug where the game would erroneously show as running in Steam after game shutdown if the Game Manual was opened during the game session with certain PDF viewers. [b]NOTE: This means for now that a file browser window will open instead in the game data directory where the Game Manual is located. I will have a better solution in a later game update.[/b]

notes.content:

More details are in this patch's accompanying weekly report.[/i][/p][p][i]NOTE: This update will partially break replays that had a ??? item attempt to target a player already over the finish line. This is only a visual bug and won't appear in new replays.[/i][/p][p][i]NOTE: The game manual currently still references the old Splitscreen multiplayer systems, this will be rectified in a future update.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Added the first wave of Steam Achievements![/b] Enjoy attempting to obtain these. Additionally, just racing normally will likely unlock a lot of them.[/p][/*][*][p]To avoid confusing new players, the Player Profile menu is now accessed via a separate button in the Main Menu, rather than the Steam profile tile in the top-left.[/p][/*][*][p]The game now only needs 5 races to achieve Rat Racing Apprentice (down from 10)[/p][/*][*][p]The game now makes it obvious if onboarding is in progress, with the remaining races required to complete onboarding; this notification appears on the left side of the "Join Rat Race" menu.[/p][/*][*][p]The game now displays a notification to tell the player the performance ratio calibration has completed. This information is accessible via the player profile menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Splitscreen multiplayer has been partially overhauled:[/p][list][*][p]Now, instead of selecting how many players will play a race, players are now required to press START or the equivalent button to "join" their controller to the play session. The player controller icons on the bottom of the screen reflect this. Physically disconnecting a controller or turning it off will automatically remove a player.[/p][/*][*][p]Due to this overhaul, it is no longer possible to change input device from KBM to Gamepad and vice versa during gameplay. Additionally, all controllers need to be disconnected to change back to Keyboard input while inside the Main Menu. [/p][/*][*][p]Player controllers no longer rearrange themselves after the race finishes if a controller got disconnected then reconnected during gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The player number select screen in the Main menu has been replaced with a Race Start confirmation:[/p][list][*][p]Splitscreen participants can now change their Rat colour from the new "Ready to Race?" screen that replaces the old "How many players?" screen.[/p][/*][*][p]In addition, in singleplayer, this screen gives Player 1 the ability to change their Rat fur colour without entering the Player Profile menu first.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added Bronze, Silver and Gold Rat colours obtainable by ranking up as you play more races; look out for them! [/p][list][*][p]The Bronze skin is awarded for Rat Racing Conoisseurs, the Silver skin for Rat Racing Champions and the Gold Skin for Rat Racing Legends.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fur shading on Rats has been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Shading on Rats' eyes have been improved slightly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where audio volumes on startup were quieter than intended if not at 100% until the Options Menu's audio controls were adjusted and/or the game was paused then unpaused again.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where background music didn't loop properly on the first loop.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where world shadows sometimes didn't render properly at specific track sizes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the publisher logos would stutter badly if the graphics driver was updated and/or the game was launched for the first time on a new computer. The game now properly waits for this process to finish.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a regression with the previous update's CPU-side optimisations that completely broke audio in splitscreen multiplayer for other viewports. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug introduced by the previous update that caused Player 4's audio in 4-player splitscreen to be distorted.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked the volume levelling and balance for 4-player splitscreen's speaker allocation to sound close to singleplayer's volume in most circumstances; please provide feedback if you play this mode often![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an oversight that caused Dialog windows (example: Rat Racing Rank notifications) to have extra buttons that didn't actually do anything useful. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where ??? items would disappear completely while in flight if near the finish line. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Replay List would stop working after viewing a replay then exiting it via the pause menu until a normal race was played.[/p][/*][/list][p]Known issues:[/p][list][*][p]In splitscreen multiplayer, some distant vehicles at high velocities are sometimes louder than intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Sometimes spent Missiles in splitscreen games leave behind a persistent Missile flight sound in the game world.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: [b]Added the first wave of Steam Achievements![/b] Enjoy attempting to obtain these. Additionally, just racing normally will likely unlock a lot of them.
To avoid confusing new players, the Player Profile menu is now accessed via a separate button in the Main Menu, rather than the Steam profile tile in the top-left.

tags.balance_change: The game now only needs 5 races to achieve Rat Racing Apprentice (down from 10)

tags.feature: The game now makes it obvious if onboarding is in progress, with the remaining races required to complete onboarding; this notification appears on the left side of the "Join Rat Race" menu.
The game now displays a notification to tell the player the performance ratio calibration has completed. This information is accessible via the player profile menu.
Splitscreen multiplayer has been partially overhauled:

Now, instead of selecting how many players will play a race, players are now required to press START or the equivalent button to "join" their controller to the play session. The player controller icons on the bottom of the screen reflect this. Physically disconnecting a controller or turning it off will automatically remove a player.

Due to this overhaul, it is no longer possible to change input device from KBM to Gamepad and vice versa during gameplay. Additionally, all controllers need to be disconnected to change back to Keyboard input while inside the Main Menu.
Player controllers no longer rearrange themselves after the race finishes if a controller got disconnected then reconnected during gameplay.
The player number select screen in the Main menu has been replaced with a Race Start confirmation:
Splitscreen participants can now change their Rat colour from the new "Ready to Race?" screen that replaces the old "How many players?" screen.
In addition, in singleplayer, this screen gives Player 1 the ability to change their Rat fur colour without entering the Player Profile menu first.
Added Bronze, Silver and Gold Rat colours obtainable by ranking up as you play more races; look out for them!
The Bronze skin is awarded for Rat Racing Conoisseurs, the Silver skin for Rat Racing Champions and the Gold Skin for Rat Racing Legends.
Fur shading on Rats has been improved.
Shading on Rats' eyes have been improved slightly.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where audio volumes on startup were quieter than intended if not at 100% until the Options Menu's audio controls were adjusted and/or the game was paused then unpaused again.
Fixed a bug where background music didn't loop properly on the first loop.
Fixed a bug where world shadows sometimes didn't render properly at specific track sizes.

Fixed an issue where the publisher logos would stutter badly if the graphics driver was updated and/or the game was launched for the first time on a new computer. The game now properly waits for this process to finish.
Fixed a regression with the previous update's CPU-side optimisations that completely broke audio in splitscreen multiplayer for other viewports.
Fixed a bug introduced by the previous update that caused Player 4's audio in 4-player splitscreen to be distorted.

tags.balance_change: Tweaked the volume levelling and balance for 4-player splitscreen's speaker allocation to sound close to singleplayer's volume in most circumstances; please provide feedback if you play this mode often!

tags.bug: Fixed an oversight that caused Dialog windows (example: Rat Racing Rank notifications) to have extra buttons that didn't actually do anything useful.
Fixed an issue where ??? items would disappear completely while in flight if near the finish line.
Fixed a bug where the Replay List would stop working after viewing a replay then exiting it via the pause menu until a normal race was played.

notes.title: Wednesday bug bash update.
notes.content:
G'day Rat Racers!
Here is a set of bug fixes and game adjustments to improve the gameplay experience.

[list]
[*] Item balance has been adjusted: 
- Boost obtained from consuming Cheese dropped by another player reduced from 64ms to 16ms
- Portable Dash Ring drop chance increased from 18% to 19%
- ??? Item drop chance decreased from 2% to 1%
- ??? Item no longer randomly explodes in circumstances where it has otherwise no reason to self-destruct. 
[*] Missiles now warn the player they're locked on to with an "INCOMING" crosshair.
[*] Being baited by the Cheese Item now causes slowed sparks to appear on the player's vehicle.
[*] Reworked the Collision Detection for the Cheese item when dropped. This fixes the following issues:
- Sometimes collisions with dropped Cheese in Replays didn't replay correctly.
- When already eating a piece of Cheese, players were briefly blocked by dropped Cheese on the road.
[*] Improved CPU artificial intelligence in cases where targeting an Item Container's more favourable than targeting a Dash Ring.
[*] Optimised CPU and memory garbage collection performance of Item Containers and their visual effects.
[*] Optimised CPU and memory garbage collection performance of Mini Volcanoes' fireballs in Volcanic.
[*] Optimised CPU and memory garbage collection performance of Coconuts present in Beach.
[*] Optimised CPU and memory garbage collection performance for ALL Explosion effects.
[*] Optimised CPU and memory garbage collection performance of Bombs, Cheese and Shields. 
[*] Introduced asynchronous race loading; if this causes hangs, please launch the game with "-disable-async-load" in your Steam launch options.
[*] Fixed a hang on AMD graphics cards running Radeon Software 22.6.1 when loading into a race or back into the menus.
[*] Fixed a rare crash on NVIDIA graphics cards when loading into a race or back into the menus.
[*] Fixed a rare hang on NVIDIA graphics cards when loading into a race or back into the menus.
[*] Changed certain physics interactions to be more deterministic; now Replays should reproduce close to exactly the same as the original match it was recorded from, as well as making bomb bounces more predictable.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed players to cancel gravity while in freefall by using certain items.
[*] Fixed a bug where thrown away items (in Item Containers) that hadn't yet landed on the ground could physically block players.
[*] Fixed a bug that made it possible to throw away items while eating.
[*] Fixed an edge case with Missiles at their maximum flight speed where it was possible for them to miss a target going around a corner while also going round said corner themselves.
[*] Fixed Replays showing the incorrect estimated race time. Older replay files will show --'--"--- instead.
[*] Fixed a case where it was possible to fail to finish a race in Forest if the player finishing was too far to the sides of the finish line when crossing it.
[/list]
[b]Note that older Replay files will break in various ways this patch: Missiles will no longer replay correctly and the Cheese may function erratically in old replay files. Additionally, old replay files will also display 00'00"000 for their EST time as it wasn't originally stored in the replay data. [/b]

notes.title: New Rattus Velocitas patch released.
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the game to hang if using a wireless PlayStation(R) controller with rumble enabled. (NOTE: Rumble still requires connecting said PlayStation(R) Controller via USB)
[b]This resolves the known issue where having controllers connected wirelessly with rumble enabled freezes the game; the workarounds are not needed anymore.[/b]
[*]Fixed a bug where toggling the reduce buffering setting didn't reload the graphics settings automatically.
[*]Made reduce buffering off the default setting for new installations; on systems that only meet the minimum GPU specifications, this setting may cause stuttering so it's recommended to keep this setting off there. 
[*]Fixed Missile targeting sometimes skipping targets when fired with a viable target directly in front of you.
[*]Improved visibility of the road in Forest by lining extra rocks along the sides.
[*]Updated the Game Manual's Troubleshooting section to reflect this patch's changes.
[/list]

[b]Please note this patch breaks replay files made in previous versions, due to the missile targeting changes.[/b]

notes.title: Day 0 bugfixes released.
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where the Performance Ratio could swing wildly in one direction after a streak of failing to beat the EST time then a race where you did beat it. This was rather prominent on fresh saves, now fresh saves should have a more stable performance ratio. Saves from the release build of this game will eventually correct themselves as well.
- Fixed an issue where the wrong slash character ('/' instead of '\') was used when displaying the Performance Ratio in the Player Profile
- Adjusted the audio mix of the Ghost Missile (??? item) explosion to make it more distinguishable from a Shield shattering.
- Fixed a bug where dropped Cheese didn't properly disable it's glow effect when picked up.
